quest.title: Sage Supreme
quest.description: The fateful day of the Epic Feast Showdown has arrived, and you hunger for the taste of challenge.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Head to the venue of the Epic Feast Showdown

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Oh, hey! You're here!

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: It's been a while! When Varesa told me you signed up for the Epic Feast Showdown, I could barely believe it!

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Sounds like Varesa might finally be in for a challenge this year!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Ahh... Honestly... I'm not even that good...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong? Sounds like you're still half-asleep...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Just hungry... It's competition day, so... Gotta show up with an empty stomach...

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Not much longer, Varesa. Atolli's firing up the ovens as we speak.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Got it... I can... wait...

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Oh, about the competition... Usually, you have to pay for the food if you don't finish.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: But, when I heard you two were coming, I talked to Atolli, and we agreed to waive your expenses!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really!? So, we get to eat for free?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Awesome! Now, we can just take it easy and box-up whatever we don't finish!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, we appreciate the generosity.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Please, it's our pleasure! You've done so much for Natlan. Just think of it as a small token of gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: When the Abyss invaded, we weren't hit with large waves of monsters, but the volcano became unusually active.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: As the Guardians of Tollan, we couldn't stand by and do nothing, so we immediately dispatched a team to the summit.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Varesa was a key member of that team.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Varesa?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hm? Oh, right! Yes, I was there! I brought so many Saurus Crackers with me that day... Ah, sorry. Not the point...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: There were Abyss Tumors all around the summit, agitating the magma and spawning all kinds of monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: But, once the Pyro Archon did her thing, we were able to smash them to smithereens.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Looking back on it, the goal was probably to hold us up so we couldn't send reinforcements to the areas around the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good point... Your tribe must be full of great warriors, with all the training you do... The Abyss really is a cunning enemy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and you mentioned something about the "Guardians of Tollan." What does that mean?

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Hahaha, that is a duty our people have held for generations.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: The volcano is very important to us. It brings disaster... but also opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Our people rose to the challenge of living in this environment, and in return, we get fertile soil and a thriving ecosystem.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: That's right! The Natlanese are never ones to shy away from a challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Although, whenever we spot unusual volcanic activity, we always report it to the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so there's a lot more to this place than good food, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on, where did Varesa go? Wasn't she just here?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Oh, y'know, I just saw her leave. I thought someone must have called for her.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Ha, my guess is that she followed the scent of the food straight to the kitchen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go check on her! Paimon understands the torture of an empty stomach better than anyone...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I'll lead the way.

talks.objective: Go to the kitchen and check on Varesa

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: That smell... So delicious...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Juicy mushrooms, melted cheese, mouthwatering steak... *salivating*...

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: Ah, look who it is.

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: I thought I felt an... intense energy around here. I know better than to get between you and your next meal, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: The food just needs a few more minutes. Here, this should tide you over in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Wait, is this... braised meat stew? Thank you, Uncle Atolli!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: *gulp*... Ahhhhhh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Varesa! You really did head straight for the kitchen... Um, what's up? You seemed lost in your own world just now.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you... Sorry! I completely spaced out just now.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: The next thing I knew, I was all the way over here with a bowl of stew in my hands.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Hahaha, don't worry about it. I think we can all guess what happened.

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: Prep took longer than usual, so I had to push back the competition. Sorry for making you wait, Varesa, especially on an empty stomach.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: No worries, Uncle Atolli! Your delicious soup fixed me right up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, that sounds more like the Varesa we know.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I become completely useless when I'm hungry. I really wanted to focus on the conversation back there, but... no luck.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: That's perfectly normal. It takes a lot of energy to train the way you do, so you need more food to make up for it.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: You two know what I mean, right? Try to do too much on an empty stomach, and you end up feeling weak and lightheaded.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, boy. Paimon's been there before.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: So, when is the competition supposed to start? Not sure I can wait much longer...

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: One sec — I'll go check.

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: We're all set! Time to gather the contestants, Acatl. The Showdown is about to begin!

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Got it!

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Let's head to the venue. The food will be brought out shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Finally! I'm so ready to dig in!

talks.objective: Take part in the Epic Feast Showdown

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, it smells SO good! Varesa had the right idea — it's definitely worth the wait!

choices.text: Yep, it looks great.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... We could MAYBE finish one portion between the two of us, and even that's a stretch. But, one portion each? There's no chance...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Time to dig in! Thanks for the food, Uncle Atolli!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, hold on! Varesa's plate looks completely different than ours!

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: Hahaha, I forgot to mention, the competition actually has two levels — the "regular challenge" and the "Varesa challenge."

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: The Varesa challenge is only for people who have completed the regular challenge in the past.

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: It's named after Varesa because... well, so far, she's the only one who's been able to finish it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're kidding... You had to invent a whole new challenge just for her?

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: Believe me, if Varesa competed in the same class as everyone else, the winner would be decided before the competition even started. What's the fun in that?

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: Only one other person has come close to beating the Varesa challenge, and that would be the Pyro Archon herself.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait, you're saying Mavuika has done this before?

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: Of course. She breezed through the normal level, but the Varesa challenge was still too much, even for her.

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: Back then, it was all part of an investigation. You see, the Pyro Archon covers all expenses at the Weary Inn the night before the Pilgrimage. And, each time, Varesa's tab would show several dozen people's worth of food for a single person.

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: The Speaker's Chamber thought something had to be wrong. Maybe there was a mistake in the accounts, or someone was trying to defraud the Archon...

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: But, once the Archon finally saw Varesa's appetite in action, that was that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa... Okay, so...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're saying... Mavuika had these portions, and she just... "breezed through"?

choices.text: Let's just go for it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're right! Let's go! Paimon's gonna defend her honor with everything she's got!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Tender, juicy, grilled to perfection... It's delicious!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: *eating ravenously*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You gotta try this one, too, {NICKNAME}! It's amazing! Ooh, and this!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: *eating ravenously*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And this one is... *burp*...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, that's it... Paimon taps out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All this time, and it doesn't look like we've made any progress...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Paimon's ready to throw in the towel...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What happened to defending your honor?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay — Paimon's tried as hard as she could, but this enemy is too strong...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know what? There really should be a "Paimon challenge"! Paimon's smaller than the rest of you. It's no fair for her portion to be the same!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Ahhhhhh...

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: Let's hear it for Varesa, who has once again completed the challenge!

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: And, with a ten percent increase in portion size, it's a new personal best!

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: Well done, Varesa!

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Amazing job!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, it's nothing! Uncle Atolli's food is just too good. I couldn't stop myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You actually finished it... Geez, are you okay?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hm? Why wouldn't I be?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You don't feel bloated? Or like you're gonna throw up? Paimon's so full, it feels like she's gonna sink...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, nope. I feel good, actually. Satisfied, y'know?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Spoken like a true champion...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Thanks! This is my specialty, after all — not that it's good for anything outside these competitions.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: If I'm honest, I'd rather be like you or Coach Iansan — a hero brave enough to stand against the Abyss!

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Don't worry, Varesa. For someone as talented as you, it's only a matter of time before you shine in the arena.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Iansan! Did you beat the challenge, too?

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Of course! The regular challenge is easy for me. I've attempted the Varesa challenge a few times, too... But, never even came close.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's still pretty amazing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, there has to be more to this than just appetite. Is there some kind of trick?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By the end, it was like the meat turned into one big, greasy blob, and it was so hard to keep going...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, that's when you balance it out with some mushrooms! The ones from my orchard.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That's what I did, anyway. As soon as the food came out, I set a few mushrooms to the side, so they wouldn't soak up too much oil.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Or get too mushy. That way, you have something fresh and fruity to balance it out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh, so that's the secret! Use the mushrooms to cut through the heaviness!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That's right! You tried them yourselves, remember? If it tastes like a fruit, might as well use it like one.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I think more people from outside the tribe would beat the challenge if they knew about that mushroom.

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: Iansan, some of the contestants are looking for you. Something about being ready to train?

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: They want to exercise? After all that food!? ...Sorry, everyone. I should intervene.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, go tell them to take it easy!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Well, how did everyone do, Uncle Atolli?

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: Almost half finished the regular challenge. I believe that's a record!

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: Either the contestants are getting more experienced, or my cooking was extra good this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, everything was delicious! Especially when it first came out, all hot and steaming!

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: Thank you! When cooked at high heat, that mushroom has a special fragrance that really brings out the flavor of the other ingredients.

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: Oh, and since you're new here, I should mention something else about that mushroom.

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: It's an excellent addition to any dish, but there are actually two varieties — red, which is the most common, and green.

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: There's not much to note about the red ones — sell them, eat them, do whatever you want. But, if you see a green one, it must be picked and eaten right away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Why's that?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That's just what a scholar from Sumeru said when the orchard first opened.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: No one knows the reason. We just do as we're told.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Whenever a green mushroom pops up in the orchard, I pick it and eat it. The flavor is identical to the red ones.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, because that's not weirdly specific at all...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't you want to know the reason behind it?

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: Well... of course! Who wouldn't be intrigued by something like that? But curiosity isn't always a good thing, right?

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: Oh, by the way, Varesa, I'm almost out of red mushrooms. Could you run to the orchard and grab some more for me?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Of course, Uncle Atolli! I'm on it!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Wanna come with, you two?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Paimon wouldn't mind working off some of that food...

choices.text: (I'm intrigued about this mushroom.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon will take that as a yes! Alright, let's go! Thanks for the food, Atolli!

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: Haha, my pleasure! But, try to finish it all next time!

choices.text: (I should see what Varesa thinks.)
It'll only get harder as the food gets cold.
These portions, though...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Phew, after that meal, I'm ready to tackle anything!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, something on your mind? Is it what Uncle Atolli said about the green mushrooms? Don't worry, he can be a bit... dramatic sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: The green mushrooms don't appear that often. Besides, I check the orchard every day, and if I see one, I eat it.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: If anything, I wish there were more around here — means more free mushrooms for me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... is that one right there? Huh, talk about a coincidence...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, it really is green...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: See? There's nothing special about it except the color.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Gimme one sec. I'll start a fire and grill it right up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's gonna pass on this one... She's way too stuffed from earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wonder why that scholar said what he said...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: You mean, why we have to pick and eat the green mushrooms right away?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Mmm... To be honest, I'm curious, too. The scholar looked really serious when he said it, but he never explained the reason behind it.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Uncle Atolli has a point, though. Curiosity can be a bad thing. If we stop doing what that scholar said, something terrible could happen...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You could look into it at least... That's what an adventurer would do.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah, but... my tribe is more important. I love everything about this place. Maintaining the status quo is good enough for me.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I know the truth is important, too. But, I don't have the right to make a decision that could put the people around me in danger.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: In other words... *sigh* Deep down, I guess I'm just scared — scared that "change" could mean losing control...

choices.text: If you're strong enough to uncover the truth...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: C—Command the truth?

choices.text: If fear is the only thing stopping you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We don't have to stop following the scholar's orders. We can start by gathering information.

choices.text: You're right — curiosity can be a bad thing...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hm... You have a point!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hehe, y'know, you remind me of another hero from our tribe. Her name was Fietena.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Just like you, she was full of courage, and never stopped challenging and exploring the unknown... She's my idol!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Actually, could you give me a moment? All I need is three seconds... Lady Fietena, lend me your courage.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Three, two, one...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You're right! I can't keep running from the truth. I... want to command it, just like you said.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: So, where should we start with the investigation? You probably have a bunch of experience.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think I should taste it first.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, the green mushroom, you mean? The taste is the same as the red ones. There's nothing special there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, {NICKNAME} is a lot more... perceptive than most people. {M#He}{F#She} should at least give it a try.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, I see... Then, I'll grill some up right away!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Varesa cooks the mushrooms, and everyone digs in. Just like Varesa said, the taste is the same.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So, notice anything, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nope. No difference in taste.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just like Varesa said... Guess it was the same for all of us.
Finally, a worthy devotee after all this time... Fascinating.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who... who said that!?

No need for alarm. There is only one among you who piqued my interest, and that is the one with golden hair. Seeing as you all appear to be acquainted, I allowed the rest of you to hear my voice as well.
Now, I shall grant you all the honor of becoming my first subjects in this era.

choices.text: Cut to the chase.

response.text: Now, now... YOU were the ones who wanted to learn more about my origins. I merely granted your wish.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Origins... Wait, YOU'RE the green mushroom!?
Ah, so you do know how to use your brain, young one. You'll excuse me if I have no interest in you — craven and dull-witted as you usually seem.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, watch it, buddy!
Heh, let me remind you, it was your own curiosity that started all of this. I see no reason for me to stand down.
I only granted you this audience because I saw potential in you.

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: I am the Sage-Lord of Fungi. Serving me is a great honor, as well as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah, Sage-Lord? Good one... Did you come up with that yourself?

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: You mock my name? Hmph, all you do is make a mockery of your own taste!

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: Ahem... Of course, the Sage-Lord of Fungi is too dignified for petty arguments with lesser organisms.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Sure doesn't sound like it...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Nope.

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: That's enough out of you! What's wrong with you humans? You should be full of reverence at this point...

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: Uh, in that case! I don't know what went wrong, but you lack the trust and worship to be my subjects, so we shall have to table that for the time being.

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: However, I am willing to share my sagely knowledge with you. I have all the answers you seek.

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: As with all seekers of said knowledge, all you have to do is prove your sincerity, and we shall see if you're worthy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look, more green mushrooms! Right in front of us!

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: These clones are my most loyal subjects as well as the keepers of my secrets.

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: If you want answers, then gather your wits and search for clues. I shall await your summons.

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: It might be advisable to brush up on your devotion in the meantime...

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: Hehehehe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The voice is gone... Finally! Paimon had enough of that racket!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Talking in our heads without permission, spewing a bunch of nonsense... Even Ajaw is better than him!

choices.text: Definitely.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: So, do you think what he said was true? About being the Sage-Lord of Fungi and all that...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe, but most of it sounded like hot air to Paimon.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We may not know who he is, but we know he exists.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: True, that conversation in our heads definitely was real...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And it proves these mushrooms aren't regular mushrooms at all. Something fishy is going on!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Which means we made the right call to investigate.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I guess this is the beginning of our hero's journey, then. So, let's make like heroes and get to the bottom of this... so we can command the truth and this mushroom!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Uh, okay, that sounded a lot cooler in my head...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we have one thing going for us — we've faced mushrooms before, and they're pretty pathetic as far as enemies go.

response.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
response.text: Ugh, such insolence!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Did you hear that? Sounds like someone's mad.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're spying on us!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: ...No response. Guess he's not gonna admit it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, he said his "subjects" hold the clues to his secrets... Who knows if he was telling the truth, but we can't just ignore the green mushrooms. So, let's start investigating!

choices.text: I still think Ajaw is worse.
You talk a big talk, but I've heard that before.
But, what you don't know can still hurt you.
Let us help you shoulder the burden.
You're strong enough to command the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, a green mushroom... And, it turned into a Fungus. Nice try, but you're not scaring Paimon with that one twice!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, let's go on the initiative! Hey, you — what's the whole "food is sacred" thing about?

dialogues.speaker: Asmu
dialogues.text: As our Sage-Lord stated, you must demonstrate your wits to receive the answers you seek. That means I should be the one asking the questions, not you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so it turns out this one can talk... Fine. What do we have to do? Solve a riddle or something?

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: A riddle? I'm not good at that... Could you, um, give us an easy one?

dialogues.speaker: Asmu
dialogues.text: That sounds like a problem for your friends. Besides, did I say this was up for negotiation!?

choices.text: I'm not a fan of riddles, either.

response.speaker: Asmu
